newsitem.title: ITALY: EMU must be launched as soon as possible - Italy PM.
newsitem.headline: EMU must be launched as soon as possible - Italy PM.

text.p: European economic and monetary union (EMU) should be launched as soon as possible, Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi said on Monday.
"I'm in favour of following the EMU timetable. This is the only way we can win the challenge from Asia and the United States," Prodi told a convention in this northern Italian city.
"We cannot delay the launch of EMU but rather start it as soon as possible," he said.
However, the Italian premier admitted that the project was going through a period of uncertainty. "This is the worse moment," he told the convention.
He said that if Europe hesitated, growth prospects with the EU would be damaged.

The EMU timetable has been thrown into doubt over the past two weeks, with a surprise Socialist victory in the French general election raising concerns the new government will not stick to the austerity measures necessary to qualify for EMU.
The shelving of a German government plan to revalue gold reserves to help improve its deficit ratios means even Bonn may struggle to meet the Maastricht criteria.
